long_description:
## Changes

### Features

- Remove Reorder toggle: drag-and-drop is now always active with inline GripVertical handle in each card's header bar

### Bug Fixes

- Enable changelog buttons when update is available (no longer blocked by missing release body)
- Fix show_update_modal race condition on startup (setting now respected after async settings load)
- Fix Override button hover to use native outline variant behavior (eliminates conflicting hover classes)
